liquidity.factor: PC1 of standardized original three proxies; fit only on complete2000-2004 quote observations, freeze means/scales/loadings, orient positive illiquidity; report loadings/variance and complete-case counts.
liquidity.additional_measure_definition: Log annual USD traded value divided by within-year median USD market capitalization, requiring120 impact days and positive denominator; not exact share turnover. Daily-return SD requires120 return days and price variation.
liquidity.weight_timing: GDP and market cap fixed at g-1 for treated and control countries. Normalize within cohort arms; aggregate cohorts by treated weight mass. Each weighted design has an equal-country comparison on exactly its eligible country/cohort support.
liquidity.primary_comparison: g+1 versus g-1; same quote-country units observed in both years; at least30 units per country and3 later-case control countries per cohort.
liquidity.robustness_matrix: Baseline: all6 outcomes x all6 country weights, plus same-sample equal baselines. Other configurations: original three proxies plus factor x equal-country and constant-GDP weights; no arbitrary Cartesian combinations of filters.
liquidity.balanced_dynamic_profile: Quotes and countries observed at every g-3..g+3; controls have recorded G>g+3; g-1 reference; compare equal and constant-GDP weights. Constant supporting sample within each family-outcome profile.
liquidity.sensitivity: Assignment-cluster deletion ranges, concentration, maximum treated weight, effective weighted treated-country count; ranges are not confidence intervals. Report every unsupported cell and attrition.
liquidity.formal_inference: No causal-effect p-values from the incomplete case inventory. Do not relabel deletion ranges as confidence intervals or descriptive event profiles as validated causal event studies.

diffusion.source_reference: Koning, Mertens and Roosenboom2018 JIBS, supplied PDF pages7-10,Tables2-5. Primary source trade measure is mean adoption among five most correlated export-pattern competitors; learning is relative median GDP growth among ten geographic neighbors; cultural/admin peers are distinct from expert-community IFAC advocacy.
diffusion.source_coverage: Conditional on documented cases. Exclude coordinated focal cases using existing national-choice flag. Main competitor share is among observed dated neighbors only, requiring3of5 known neighbors; report missing fraction and bounds. Strict sensitivity requires4of5. Neighbors are selected before inspecting policy adoption status.
diffusion.trade_data: COW raw directional flows, not smoothed series. Negative/missing flows remain missing; Pearson correlation on at least20 jointly observed destination markets. Deterministic ISO tie break. No future-year trade weights.
diffusion.learning: Foreign recorded G<=t-2; growth or liquidity observed no later than t-1; later-case comparators recorded G>t-1. Geographic nearest10 selected independently of policy data. Require at least one measured earlier and later case and80percent signal coverage in both groups. Missing comparison groups remain missing. Benchmarked success uses g-1..g+1 balanced-quote contrasts available by t-1, excludes focal-country and its assignment cluster from foreign controls; at least3 remaining controls.
diffusion.coercion: WDI credit series includes SDR allocations; aid is not policy conditionality. Preserve missing observations, including nonreporting higher-income countries. Report standalone components and combined author-style proxy; no claim of verified coercion.
diffusion.emulation: Language, legal-origin and general IGO peer exposure are partial proxies. No claim to reproduce Berry cultural/admin composite without religion or to replace IFAC professional advocacy. Historical source availability/snapshot limits retained.
diffusion.likelihood: Binomial logit; family-year stratum fixed effects, after excluding constant-outcome strata. Country-cluster covariance, Student-t reference with countries-1df. LPM uses same sample and fixed effects. Standardize continuous slopes within exact estimation sample; record all dropped constant nuisance terms and rank checks.
diffusion.stability: Converged, no estimation warnings, finite coefficients/SE, abs coefficient below25 and full-rank design; otherwise retain diagnostics and withhold interpretation.
diffusion.multiplicity: Holm across every estimable new focal coefficient, with raw and adjusted p-values. Also identify the narrower primary family. Single and combined fits and LPM sensitivity are disclosed, never chosen for significance.
diffusion.no_real_time_claim: Feature calendar dates precede focal year; historical releases, current vintage revisions and historical quote selection remain unaudited. Fixed2000 and fixed2013 networks are distinct specifications, not imputed annual observations.

writing_principles: Define the economic construct before presenting its proxy.
Explain each table's exact sample, timing and unit before interpreting coefficients.
Connect magnitude and economic meaning, with conditional-design limits stated in the same paragraph.
Distinguish descriptive comparisons, nominal inference and multiplicity-adjusted inference.
Report unsupported/null/unstable results without switching specifications for favorable signs.
